summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the engine-free plot function, and rewired the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard handlers as thin adapters. Changes are uncommitted and nothing was executed: no tests were run and flake8 was not run, so the new tests and the ignite 0.3.0 attach behavior are unverified. Line length, trailing whitespace, and file endings were checked by hand. Files: new monai/data/csv_saver.py, monai/data/nifti_saver.py, and tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Modified monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, monai/handlers/{segmentation_saver,classification_saver,tensorboard_handlers}.py, monai/data/nifti_writer.py (dtype default np.float32), tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py, tests/integration_sliding_window.py, and examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_{array,dict}.py (output_path renamed to output_dir).
